messages:
maya: Evening — quick onboarding check for Samir (starts 9am PT tomorrow). Background check vendor flagged SSN formatting but vendor marked as resolved; the portal still shows 'pending'. Can we get an evening I-9 dropbox slot (6:30pm) and a badge courier hold? Also can we slot a short benefits Q&A during orientation (~10:45am)? Thanks!
people-ops-bot: Hi @maya — noted. Reserving an evening dropbox slot at 6:30pm at HQ and flagging Samir for badge hold. Please confirm Samir's preferred courier address and the vendor case ID.
ashley: I can handle courier pickup and badge hold. What's the address? Paste vendor ID so I can follow up with the background vendor.
maya: Vendor case ID: 9A3-2024. Address: 80 Pine St, SF 94111, Apt 5B. Samir will be hybrid and will need a shuttle pass for week 1.
samir: Hi all — confirmed address and 9am PT start. Evening dropbox works for me. I'm on APAC hours (UTC+8) — will the benefits Q&A be recorded or can we arrange a 1:1? 
jeff: IT here — laptop imaging scheduled for 8:45am with pickup at Desk 3. If Samir prefers we can leave it at concierge, or arrange an evening handoff if ops provides a signed LOA.
ashley: I'll add the LOA to the courier manifest. badge-hold code created: BH-174600. Also added shuttle pass to the manifest.
people-ops-bot: Done — evening slot 6:30pm booked, courier pickup scheduled 6:00pm, badge hold BH-174600, LOA included. Benefits Q&A will be recorded; we'll DM Samir the recording and offer a 1:1 time window tomorrow EOD.
maya: Perfect, thank you :thumbsup: 
samir: Thanks everyone — quick last Q: for I-9 at the dropbox do I need the physical SSN card or is driver's license + passport sufficient?
people-ops-bot: Driver's license + passport are acceptable for List A verification. Original documents required at the dropbox. If anything is expired or vendor flags an issue, message ops immediately and we'll book an in-person alternative.
